approval_source: Explicit user SIGA in current conversation, scoped only to SWHNK-L03-BINAH-CURRICULUM-LANE-ALLOCATION-SOURCE-ARCHITECTURE-HUMAN-BATCH-V1.

architecture_decisions.statement: Approve LEXICAL_AND_TEACHER_SOURCE_REVIEW: all four approved semantic lanes may be reviewed as source evidence for later Vocabulary and Teacher Notes mapping, without assigning any slot under this gate.
Approve INTERACTION_PATTERN_HOLD: OPI and QA may reference CONTEXT_PLACE, ACTIVITY and INTENTION_NEED_PURPOSE only after a separate pattern source review; no question/answer grammar is inferred here.
Approve STRUCTURE_PATTERN_HOLD: Structure Headers and Structures require a separate source/pattern review; 'I usually...' remains unresolved and SARU cannot fill it by itself.
Approve DERIVED_CONTENT_HOLD: Story, Activation and Review may only derive from separately governed and validated L03 payloads; no derived content is created here.

Preserve the exact L03 curriculum contract of 139 slots (3 Teacher Notes, 10 OPI, 5 Story, 4 QA, 2 Structure Headers, 5 Structures, 16 Vocabulary, 72 Activation, 22 Review) without assigning any individual slot under this gate.
Keep all eight source bindings in their existing FROZEN/WATCH/CANDIDATE states and treat architecture routing as eligibility only, not lexical promotion or curricular implementation.

governance_decisions.statement: Architecture approval is not slot assignment, authoring, validation, runtime activation, registry rebind application or language-authority promotion.
No locative, predicate, modal, habitual, frequency, aspect, tense, morphology, interrogative, declarative or word-order grammar may be inferred from architecture routes.
SARU remains WATCH evidence for 'todos os dias / habitualidade' and is not equated to 'usually'; the HNK realization of 'I usually...' remains null.
Reference languages may compare semantics only and numerology may preserve counts only; neither selects HNK forms, grammar or slot payloads.
No L01/L02 scoped grammar is inherited as universal or L03 grammar; any reuse requires separate L03 source/pattern evidence.
If approved, prepare the first separate L03 source-to-curriculum mapping gate beginning with Vocabulary/Teacher Notes evidence; do not author any L03 payload with the same approval.
